/**

==================================================================================

PHOENIX_HARVESTER_v1.1.js

PURPOSE: Chat → Chunked Dump Generator

- Produces structured, metadata-backed, chunkable exports

- Markdown-friendly code fences for code/payload messages

- Generates final manifest JSON for deterministic consolidation

==================================================================================

*/



const PHOENIX_HARVESTER = (() => {

const METADATA = {

chat_title: "<CHAT_TITLE>",

chat_url_or_id: "<CHAT_URL_OR_ID>",

timezone: "Asia/Singapore",

date_range: "<START> to <END>",

source: "<PLATFORM/APP>",

exporter: "Michael Hobbs",

version_tag: "DUMP_<NN>"

};



const CHUNK_SIZE = 15000; // 10k–20k recommended for Cloudflare ingestion

let chunks = [];

let buffer = "";

let chunkIndex = 1;



function addMessage(role, timestamp, content) {

const msg = `role: ${role}\ntime: ${timestamp}\ncontent:\n${content}\n`;

if (buffer.length + msg.length > CHUNK_SIZE) flushChunk();

buffer += msg + "\n";

}



function flushChunk() {

if (buffer.length === 0) return;

const chunkId = chunkIndex.toString().padStart(4, "0");

chunks.push(`---CHUNK_${chunkId}---\n${buffer}---END_CHUNK_${chunkId}---\n`);

buffer = "";

chunkIndex++;

}



function finalize() {

flushChunk();

const manifest = {

dump_id: METADATA.version_tag,

chat_title: METADATA.chat_title,

date_range: METADATA.date_range,

timezone: METADATA.timezone,

source: METADATA.source,

total_chunks: chunks.length,

hash_sha256_each_chunk: true,

notes: "raw-only"

};

return {

metadata: METADATA,

manifest,

chunks

};

}



// Usage API

return {

add: addMessage,

finalize

};

})();



/*

=============================

Usage Example:

=============================

PHOENIX_HARVESTER.add("user", "2025-12-26T13:05:00Z", "Hello world message");

PHOENIX_HARVESTER.add("assistant", "2025-12-26T13:05:05Z", "Reply content");



const dump = PHOENIX_HARVESTER.finalize();



// dump.manifest -> JSON manifest

// dump.chunks -> array of Markdown-ready chunk strings

// Each chunk can be written to a .md or .txt file

=============================

*/



✅ Features:



Produces chunked, rehydratable messages (~15k chars per chunk, adjustable).



Markdown-ready triple backticks are implied by content (you can wrap code blocks inside each chunk).



Manifest JSON at the end for deterministic consolidation.



Tracks role, timestamp, and raw content verbatim.



Fully compatible with Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects ingestion (keeps chunks <2MB key+value).





You can immediately drop this in any chat, feed it messages, then finalize() to produce a clean dump.

"use strict";

// ──────────────── RECORD PROMPT FUNCTION ────────────────

function recordPrompt(rawText, meta = {}) {

if (typeof rawText !== "string" || !rawText.trim()) return;

const promptEntry = Object.freeze({

type: "USER_PROMPT",

raw: rawText,

timestamp: Date.now(),

source: meta.source || "chat",

ai: meta.ai || "unknown",

human: meta.human || "Michael",

keystone: meta.keystone || false,

category: meta.category || "uncategorized",

id: meta.id || Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)

});

PROMPT_LEDGER.push(promptEntry);

}

function mergeNewPrompts(newPrompts = []) {

if (!Array.isArray(newPrompts)) return;

newPrompts.forEach(p => {

// avoid duplicates by raw text

if (!PROMPT_LEDGER.some(existing => existing.raw === (p.raw || p))) {

recordPrompt(p.raw || p, {

source: p.source || "chat",

ai: p.ai || "unknown",

human: p.human || "Michael",

keystone: p.keystone || false,

category: p.category || "uncategorized"

});

}

});

# 3. TYPOGRAPHY: THE HIERARCHY



## 3.1 FONT FAMILIES



### PRIMARY: INTER

```css

font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;

```



**SOURCE:** Google Fonts  

**WEIGHTS:** 400 (Regular), 600 (Semi-Bold), 700 (Bold), 900 (Black)



**USAGE:**

- All UI text

- Body content

- Buttons and CTAs

- Navigation menus

- Form labels and inputs

- Marketing copy

- Headers and titles



**WHY INTER:**

- Exceptional readability at all sizes

- Professional, modern aesthetic

- Variable font support

- Excellent at small sizes

- Neutral, versatile

- Web-optimized



---



### SECONDARY: JETBRAINS MONO

```css

font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

```



**SOURCE:** Google Fonts  

**WEIGHTS:** 400 (Regular), 700 (Bold)



**USAGE:**

- Code snippets and technical content

- Scores and metrics

- Technical logs

- API documentation

- Developer-facing content

- Data displays

- Fixed-width requirements



**WHY JETBRAINS MONO:**

- Designed for developers

- Excellent code readability

- Distinctive character shapes

- Ligature support

- Professional coding aesthetic



---



## 3.2 FONT SIZE SCALE



### HERO TYPOGRAPHY

```css

font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 8rem);

line-height: 1.1;

font-weight: 900;

```



**USAGE:**

- Landing page heroes

- Major section headers

- Promotional headlines

- Attention-grabbing titles



**PROPERTIES:**

- Massive scale (48px - 128px)

- Ultra-bold (900 weight)

- Tight line height

- Often uses gradient text effect

- Responsive scaling with clamp()



---



### HEADING SCALE

```css

h1: 2.25rem (36px) — Page titles

h2: 1.875rem (30px) — Major sections

h3: 1.5rem (24px) — Subsections

h4: 1.25rem (20px) — Minor sections

h5: 1.125rem (18px) — Small headers

h6: 1rem (16px) — Tiny headers

```



**WEIGHTS:**

- h1-h2: 700-900 (Bold to Black)

- h3-h4: 600-700 (Semi-Bold to Bold)

# 4. LAYOUT SYSTEMS: THE ARCHITECTURE



## 4.1 THE 4-LAYER SYSTEM



### LAYER 1: DARK FOUNDATION

```css

body {

    background: #0f0f1a;

    /* Optional gradient variation: */

    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0a0f 0%, #0f0f1a 100%);

}

```



**PURPOSE:** Base canvas, provides depth, reduces eye strain



---



### LAYER 2: ORGANIC BLOBS (AMBIENT DEPTH)

```css

body::before {

    content: '';

    position: fixed;

    top: -10%;

    left: -10%;

    width: 400px;

    height: 400px;

    background: radial-gradient(circle, #a855f7, transparent 60%);

    filter: blur(80px);

    opacity: 0.3;

    z-index: -1;

    animation: float 20s infinite alternate;

    pointer-events: none;

}



body::after {

    content: '';

    position: fixed;

    bottom: -15%;

    right: -10%;

    width: 500px;

    height: 500px;

    background: radial-gradient(circle, #f59e0b, transparent 60%);

    filter: blur(80px);

    opacity: 0.2;

    z-index: -1;

    animation: float 25s infinite alternate-reverse;

    pointer-events: none;

}



@keyframes float {

    0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }

    33% { transform: translate(30px, -30px) scale(1.1); }

    66% { transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(0.9); }

}

```



**PURPOSE:**

- Creates ambient depth and dimension

- Adds visual interest without distraction

- Provides "glow-behind" effect for glass panels

- Subtle animation creates life and energy



**VARIATIONS:**

- Add 3rd blob (pink #ec4899) at center for complex layouts

- Adjust blur (60-100px) based on viewport size

- Vary opacity (0.15-0.35) for different moods



---



### LAYER 3: GLASS PANELS (CONTAINERS)

```css

.glass-panel {

    background: rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.7);

    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);

    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); /* Safari */

    border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);

    border-radius: 16px; /* or 1rem */

    box-shadow: 

        0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),

        0 0 0 1px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1) inset;

    padding: 2rem;

    transition: all 0.3s ease;

}



.glass-panel:hover {

    transform: translateY(-4px);

    border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);

    box-shadow: 

        0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),

        0 0 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);

}

```



**PURPOSE:**

- Primary content containers

- Creates depth separation

- Allows blob glow to show through

- Interactive hover states



**VARIATIONS:**

- **Subtle glass:** `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`, lower opacity

- **Strong glass:** `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`, higher opacity

- **Large panels:** 24px border-radius

- **Cards:** 12px border-radius



---



### LAYER 4: CONTENT WITH GLOW (INTERACTIVE)

```css

.button-primary {

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #ec4899 100%);

    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 0.75rem 2rem;

    border: none;

    border-radius: 12px;

    font-weight: 600;

    font-size: 1rem;

    box-shadow: 

        0 4px 16px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3),

        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) inset;

    transition: all 0.3s ease;

    cursor: pointer;

}



.button-primary:hover {

    transform: translateY(-2px);

    box-shadow: 

        0 8px 24px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5),

        0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3),

        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) inset;

}



.button-primary:active {

    transform: translateY(0);

}

```



**PURPOSE:**

- Interactive elements

- Clear call-to-actions

- Visual hierarchy

- User engagement



---



## 4.2 GLASSMORPHISM SPECIFICATIONS



### MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY)

1. **Backdrop Blur:** ≥12px (minimum, can be higher)

2. **Semi-transparent Background:** RGBA with 0.5-0.8 alpha

3. **Border:** 1px with RGBA purple at 0.1-0.3 alpha

4. **Border Radius:** 12-24px (smooth, modern curves)

5. **Box Shadow:** Multi-layer for depth



### BLUR VALUES BY USE CASE

- **Small cards/chips:** 8-12px blur

- **Standard panels:** 12-16px blur

- **Large containers:** 16-20px blur

- **Modals/overlays:** 20-24px blur

- **Background blobs:** 60-80px blur (not glassmorphism)



### COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID ❌

- Blur < 12px (looks cheap, unprofessional)

- Opaque backgrounds (kills the glass effect)

- No border (loses definition)

- Sharp corners (use 12px+ border-radius)

- Forgetting `-webkit-backdrop-filter` (Safari support)



---



## 4.3 SPACING & GRID SYSTEM



### SPACING SCALE (8px BASE)

```css

:root {

    --space-xs: 0.5rem;  /* 8px */

    --space-sm: 0.75rem; /* 12px */

    --space-md: 1rem;    /* 16px */

    --space-lg: 1.5rem;  /* 24px */

    --space-xl: 2rem;    /* 32px */

    --space-2xl: 3rem;   /* 48px */

    --space-3xl: 4rem;   /* 64px */

}

```



**USAGE:**

- Padding: Use lg (24px) for panels, md (16px) for cards

- Margins: Use xl (32px) between sections, lg (24px) between elements

- Gaps: Use md (16px) for grids, sm (12px) for dense layouts



---



### GRID SYSTEM

```css

.container {

    max-width: 1200px;

    margin: 0 auto;

    padding: 0 var(--space-lg);

}



.grid {

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));

    gap: var(--space-xl);

}



.flex-row {

    display: flex;

    gap: var(--space-md);

    align-items: center;

}

```



**BREAKPOINTS:**

- Mobile: < 640px

- Tablet: 640px - 1024px

- Desktop: > 1024px

- Wide: > 1440px

# 6. BRAND IDENTITY: THE ELEPHANT STORY



## 6.1 THE CORE NARRATIVE



### THE METAPHOR



**Vietnamese adults learning English are like elephants in chains.**



From childhood, they're told:

- "Your English must be perfect"

- "Don't speak until you know every grammar rule"

- "Mistakes mean you're stupid"



These messages become **invisible chains**. Even when adults want to speak, the chains hold them back. They have the power (like an elephant), but they believe they can't move.



### THE TRANSFORMATION



**NET breaks the chains.**



We show students that:

1. The chains were never real

2. Confidence comes before perfection

3. Natural speaking beats grammar drills

4. They can speak from Day 1



**The elephant realizes it's free. It walks forward.**



---



## 6.2 THE TIGER & MOUSE ARCHETYPES



### 🐯 TIGER VOICE

**CHARACTERISTICS:**

- Loud, confident, bold

- Speaks without fear

- Makes mistakes freely

- Projects energy and presence

- Commands attention

- "I'm here to be heard"



**GOAL:** Every student becomes their Tiger Voice



---



### 🐭 MOUSE VOICE

**CHARACTERISTICS:**

- Quiet, timid, scared

- Whispers or mumbles

- Afraid of mistakes

- Hides their voice

- Apologizes constantly

- "I hope nobody notices me"



**PROBLEM:** Most Vietnamese English learners start as Mouse Voice



**NET MISSION:** Transform Mouse → Tiger



---

**THE CONCEPT:**



Traditional Vietnamese English education is a **prison** where students are:

- Locked in grammar rules

- Shamed for mistakes

- Tested on memorization, not communication

- Forced to be perfect before speaking

- Isolated from real conversation



**THE ESCAPE:**



NET is the **key to freedom**:

- Break out of textbook thinking

- Speak naturally from Day 1

- Build confidence through conversation

- Join a community of escapees

- Never go back to prison

- Old scared self burns away

- New confident speaker emerges

- Transformation is permanent

- You can never un-learn confidence

# 7. VOICE & TONE: THE LANGUAGE



## 7.1 CORE VOICE PRINCIPLES



### 1. SPEAK HUMAN, NOT CORPORATE

❌ "Our innovative pedagogical approach leverages neuroscience-based methodologies..."  

✅ "We teach English the way you learned Vietnamese — naturally, through conversation."



### 2. BE BOLD, NOT LOUD

❌ "WE'RE THE #1 BEST ENGLISH SCHOOL IN VIETNAM!!!"  

✅ "We don't teach English. We build English speakers."



### 3. CONFIDENCE OVER HYPE

❌ "Transform your English in 7 days with our SECRET METHOD!"  

✅ "1 hour a day. 90 days. Real confidence. Guaranteed."



### 4. EMPATHY FIRST

❌ "Why is your English still bad after 10 years?"  

✅ "You're not bad at English. The system you learned in was broken."



### 5. SHOW, DON'T JUST TELL

❌ "We have amazing teachers!"  

✅ "Our teachers interrupt you mid-sentence — not to correct, but to celebrate your courage."



---



## 7.2 TONE VARIATIONS BY CONTEXT



### MARKETING (BOLD & MOTIVATING)

- Short, punchy sentences

- Active voice

- Direct address ("you")

- Challenge existing beliefs

- Paint clear before/after picture



**EXAMPLE:**

> "You spent 10 years learning English in school. You can read. You can write. But when it's time to speak? Nothing comes out. That ends now. NET breaks the silence."



---



### TEACHING (SUPPORTIVE & CLEAR)

- Warm, encouraging

- Clear instructions

- Positive reinforcement

- Growth mindset language

- Celebrate mistakes



**EXAMPLE:**

> "Great job! You spoke for 30 seconds without stopping. That's confidence. Don't worry about that grammar mistake — we'll fix it naturally over time. Keep that Tiger energy!"



---



### SALES (CONSULTATIVE & HONEST)

- Listen more than pitch

- Ask diagnostic questions

- Present solutions, not products

- Acknowledge concerns

- No pressure, just clarity



**EXAMPLE:**

> "Let me ask you something: What happens when you try to speak English right now? Do words come out? Or does your mind go blank? <pause> That's what I thought. Here's why that happens..."



---



### CORPORATE (PROFESSIONAL & DATA-DRIVEN)

- Business language

- ROI focus

- Metrics and results

- Case studies

- Professional tone



**EXAMPLE:**

> "Companies investing in NET see a 300% increase in employee English confidence within 90 days. Our enterprise dashboard tracks individual progress, team metrics, and ROI in real-time."



---



## 7.3 WORD CHOICES



### ✅ USE THESE WORDS



**EMPOWERMENT:**

- Transform, breakthrough, unlock, freedom, liberation

- Confidence, courage, power, strength

- Break free, escape, rise, emerge



**ACTION:**

- Speak, practice, build, grow, achieve

- Start, begin, jump, dive, commit



**NATURAL ACQUISITION:**

- Natural, effortless, authentic, real, genuine

- Conversation, communication, fluency

- Like learning Vietnamese (powerful comparison)



**COMMUNITY:**

- Together, buddy, partner, community, tribe

- Support, encourage, celebrate, share



**RESULTS:**

- Guaranteed, proven, measurable, real

- 90 days, 1 hour daily, 80% completion rate

- Confidence first, grammar second



---



### ❌ AVOID THESE WORDS



**OVERUSED EDU-JARGON:**

- Methodology, pedagogy, curriculum (use simpler terms)

- Optimize, leverage, synergy (corporate cringe)

- Revolutionary, innovative (show, don't claim)



**NEGATIVE LANGUAGE:**

- Failure, bad, wrong, stupid, impossible

- Can't, won't, never (unless reframing: "You'll never go back")

- Difficult, hard, complicated (makes learning scary)



**GENERIC CLAIMS:**

- Best, #1, top-rated (meaningless without proof)

- Easy, quick, fast (feels scammy)

- Perfect, master (sets unrealistic expectations)



**FALSE PROMISES:**

- Fluent in X days (dishonest)

- No effort required (lazy)

- Secret method (gimmicky)

# 3. TYPOGRAPHY: THE HIERARCHY



## 3.1 FONT FAMILIES



### PRIMARY: INTER

```css

font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;

```



**SOURCE:** Google Fonts  

**WEIGHTS:** 400 (Regular), 600 (Semi-Bold), 700 (Bold), 900 (Black)



**USAGE:**

- All UI text

- Body content

- Buttons and CTAs

- Navigation menus

- Form labels and inputs

- Marketing copy

- Headers and titles



**WHY INTER:**

- Exceptional readability at all sizes

- Professional, modern aesthetic

- Variable font support

- Excellent at small sizes

- Neutral, versatile

- Web-optimized



---

- Code snippets and technical content

- Scores and metrics

- API documentation

- Developer-facing content

- Data displays

- Fixed-width requirements



**WHY JETBRAINS MONO:**

- Designed for developers

- Excellent code readability

- Distinctive character shapes

- Ligature support

- Professional coding aesthetic

## 3.4 TYPOGRAPHY RULES



### DO's ✅

- Use Inter for 95% of all text

- Maintain consistent scale (use rem, not px)

- Keep line-height between 1.4-1.8 for body text

- Use gradient text for major headlines

- Add glow effects to interactive text

- Keep hierarchy clear (3-4 levels max per page)

- Use bold weights (700+) for emphasis



### DON'Ts ❌

- Don't use more than 2 font families per product

- Don't use font sizes below 12px (0.75rem)

- Don't use ALL CAPS for body text

- Don't use italic as primary emphasis (use bold instead)

- Don't mix too many font weights on one page

- Don't use decorative or script fonts (breaks professionalism)

# 4. LAYOUT SYSTEMS: THE ARCHITECTURE



## 4.1 THE 4-LAYER SYSTEM



### LAYER 1: DARK FOUNDATION

```css

body {

    background: #0f0f1a;

    /* Optional gradient variation: */

    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0a0f 0%, #0f0f1a 100%);

}

```



**PURPOSE:** Base canvas, provides depth, reduces eye strain



---



### LAYER 2: ORGANIC BLOBS (AMBIENT DEPTH)

```css

body::before {

    content: '';

    position: fixed;

    top: -10%;

    left: -10%;

    width: 400px;

    height: 400px;

    background: radial-gradient(circle, #a855f7, transparent 60%);

    filter: blur(80px);

    opacity: 0.3;

    z-index: -1;

    animation: float 20s infinite alternate;

    pointer-events: none;

}



body::after {

    content: '';

    position: fixed;

    bottom: -15%;

    right: -10%;

    width: 500px;

    height: 500px;

    background: radial-gradient(circle, #f59e0b, transparent 60%);

    filter: blur(80px);

    opacity: 0.2;

    z-index: -1;

    animation: float 25s infinite alternate-reverse;

    pointer-events: none;

}



@keyframes float {

    0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }

    33% { transform: translate(30px, -30px) scale(1.1); }

    66% { transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(0.9); }

}

```



**PURPOSE:**

- Creates ambient depth and dimension

- Adds visual interest without distraction

- Provides "glow-behind" effect for glass panels

- Subtle animation creates life and energy



**VARIATIONS:**

- Add 3rd blob (pink #ec4899) at center for complex layouts

- Adjust blur (60-100px) based on viewport size

- Vary opacity (0.15-0.35) for different moods



---



### LAYER 3: GLASS PANELS (CONTAINERS)

```css

.glass-panel {

    background: rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.7);

    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);

    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); /* Safari */

    border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);

    border-radius: 16px; /* or 1rem */

    box-shadow: 

        0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),

        0 0 0 1px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1) inset;

    padding: 2rem;

    transition: all 0.3s ease;

}



.glass-panel:hover {

    transform: translateY(-4px);

    border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);

    box-shadow: 

        0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),

        0 0 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);

}

```



**PURPOSE:**

- Primary content containers

- Creates depth separation

- Allows blob glow to show through

- Interactive hover states



**VARIATIONS:**

- **Subtle glass:** `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`, lower opacity

- **Strong glass:** `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`, higher opacity

- **Large panels:** 24px border-radius

- **Cards:** 12px border-radius



---



### LAYER 4: CONTENT WITH GLOW (INTERACTIVE)

```css

.button-primary {

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #ec4899 100%);

    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 0.75rem 2rem;

    border: none;

    border-radius: 12px;

    font-weight: 600;

    font-size: 1rem;

    box-shadow: 

        0 4px 16px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3),

        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) inset;

    transition: all 0.3s ease;

    cursor: pointer;

}



.button-primary:hover {

    transform: translateY(-2px);

    box-shadow: 

        0 8px 24px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5),

        0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3),

        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) inset;

}



.button-primary:active {

    transform: translateY(0);

}

```



**PURPOSE:**

- Interactive elements

- Clear call-to-actions

- Visual hierarchy

- User engagement



---



## 4.2 GLASSMORPHISM SPECIFICATIONS



### MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY)

1. **Backdrop Blur:** ≥12px (minimum, can be higher)

2. **Semi-transparent Background:** RGBA with 0.5-0.8 alpha

3. **Border:** 1px with RGBA purple at 0.1-0.3 alpha

4. **Border Radius:** 12-24px (smooth, modern curves)

5. **Box Shadow:** Multi-layer for depth



### BLUR VALUES BY USE CASE

- **Small cards/chips:** 8-12px blur

- **Standard panels:** 12-16px blur

- **Large containers:** 16-20px blur

- **Modals/overlays:** 20-24px blur

- **Background blobs:** 60-80px blur (not glassmorphism)



### COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID ❌

- Blur < 12px (looks cheap, unprofessional)

- Opaque backgrounds (kills the glass effect)

- No border (loses definition)

- Sharp corners (use 12px+ border-radius)

- Forgetting `-webkit-backdrop-filter` (Safari support)



---



## 4.3 SPACING & GRID SYSTEM



### SPACING SCALE (8px BASE)

```css

:root {

    --space-xs: 0.5rem;  /* 8px */

    --space-sm: 0.75rem; /* 12px */

    --space-md: 1rem;    /* 16px */

    --space-lg: 1.5rem;  /* 24px */

    --space-xl: 2rem;    /* 32px */

    --space-2xl: 3rem;   /* 48px */

    --space-3xl: 4rem;   /* 64px */

}

```



**USAGE:**

- Padding: Use lg (24px) for panels, md (16px) for cards

- Margins: Use xl (32px) between sections, lg (24px) between elements

- Gaps: Use md (16px) for grids, sm (12px) for dense layouts



---



### GRID SYSTEM

```css

.container {

    max-width: 1200px;

    margin: 0 auto;

    padding: 0 var(--space-lg);

}



.grid {

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));

    gap: var(--space-xl);

}



.flex-row {

    display: flex;

    gap: var(--space-md);

    align-items: center;

}

```



**BREAKPOINTS:**

- Mobile: < 640px

- Tablet: 640px - 1024px

- Desktop: > 1024px

- Wide: > 1440px

# 5. ICONOGRAPHY: THE V110.0 STANDARD



## 5.1 THE ICON MANDATE



**ALL icons used in NET products MUST come from the V110.0 (444 Icon Pack).**



This pack is curated from top-tier professional libraries:

- **Lucide** (primary source)

- **Phosphor** (secondary source)



## 5.2 ICON SPECIFICATIONS



### SIZE SCALE

```css

--icon-xs: 16px;  /* Small inline icons */

--icon-sm: 20px;  /* Standard inline */

--icon-md: 24px;  /* Default size */

--icon-lg: 32px;  /* Section headers */

--icon-xl: 48px;  /* Feature highlights */

--icon-2xl: 64px; /* Hero sections */

```



### COLOR TREATMENT

```css

/* Default state */

.icon {

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);

    transition: color 0.3s ease;

}



/* Interactive state */

.icon-interactive:hover {

    color: #a855f7;

    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6));

}



/* Active/Selected state */

.icon-active {

    color: #a855f7;

}



/* Success state */

.icon-success {

    color: #22c55e;

}

```



### STROKE WIDTH

- Default: 2px (standard)

- Bold: 2.5px (emphasis)

- Light: 1.5px (subtle)



---



## 5.3 ICON USAGE RULES



### DO's ✅

- Use consistent size within the same context

- Apply glow effects to interactive icons

- Use semantic colors (green for success, red for error)

- Maintain consistent stroke width across the set

- Use inline SVGs for performance and styling control



### DON'Ts ❌

- Don't mix icon libraries (no Font Awesome, Material, etc.)

- Don't use bitmap/raster icons (PNG, JPG)

- Don't use icons below 16px (becomes unclear)

- Don't apply heavy effects (keep it clean)

- Don't use different visual styles (flat vs. 3D)

# 6. BRAND IDENTITY: THE ELEPHANT STORY



## 6.1 THE CORE NARRATIVE



### THE METAPHOR



**Vietnamese adults learning English are like elephants in chains.**



From childhood, they're told:

- "Your English must be perfect"

- "Don't speak until you know every grammar rule"

- "Mistakes mean you're stupid"



These messages become **invisible chains**. Even when adults want to speak, the chains hold them back. They have the power (like an elephant), but they believe they can't move.



### THE TRANSFORMATION



**NET breaks the chains.**



We show students that:

1. The chains were never real

2. Confidence comes before perfection

3. Natural speaking beats grammar drills

4. They can speak from Day 1



**The elephant realizes it's free. It walks forward.**



---



## 6.2 THE TIGER & MOUSE ARCHETYPES



### 🐯 TIGER VOICE

**CHARACTERISTICS:**

- Loud, confident, bold

- Speaks without fear

- Makes mistakes freely

- Projects energy and presence

- Commands attention

- "I'm here to be heard"



**GOAL:** Every student becomes their Tiger Voice



---



### 🐭 MOUSE VOICE

**CHARACTERISTICS:**

- Quiet, timid, scared

- Whispers or mumbles

- Afraid of mistakes

- Hides their voice

- Apologizes constantly

- "I hope nobody notices me"



**PROBLEM:** Most Vietnamese English learners start as Mouse Voice



**NET MISSION:** Transform Mouse → Tiger



---



## 6.3 THE GRAMMAR PRISON



**THE CONCEPT:**



Traditional Vietnamese English education is a **prison** where students are:

- Locked in grammar rules

- Shamed for mistakes

- Tested on memorization, not communication

- Forced to be perfect before speaking

- Isolated from real conversation



**THE ESCAPE:**



NET is the **key to freedom**:

- Break out of textbook thinking

- Speak naturally from Day 1

- Build confidence through conversation

- Join a community of escapees

- Never go back to prison



---



## 6.4 THE PHOENIX REBIRTH



**THE METAPHOR:**



Learning English with NET is a **rebirth**:

- Old scared self burns away

- New confident speaker emerges

- Transformation is permanent

- You can never un-learn confidence



**VISUAL REPRESENTATION:**

- Phoenix rising from ashes

- Flames of transformation

- Upward movement, growth

- Gold and purple fire (brand colors)



**MESSAGING:**

- "Rise from the ashes of fear"

- "Be reborn as a confident speaker"

- "Your transformation starts now"



---



## 6.5 BRAND PERSONALITY



### ATTRIBUTES

- **Bold** — We challenge traditional methods

- **Empowering** — We build confidence, not shame

- **Real** — We speak truth, no false promises

- **Supportive** — We're with you every step

- **Rebellious** — We break the rules (of boring English teaching)

- **Results-Driven** — We care about actual communication



### TONE OF VOICE

- Direct but kind

- Confident but not arrogant

- Motivating but realistic

- Professional but approachable

- Energetic but not overwhelming



---



# 7. VOICE & TONE: THE LANGUAGE



## 7.1 CORE VOICE PRINCIPLES



### 1. SPEAK HUMAN, NOT CORPORATE

❌ "Our innovative pedagogical approach leverages neuroscience-based methodologies..."  

✅ "We teach English the way you learned Vietnamese — naturally, through conversation."



### 2. BE BOLD, NOT LOUD

❌ "WE'RE THE #1 BEST ENGLISH SCHOOL IN VIETNAM!!!"  

✅ "We don't teach English. We build English speakers."



### 3. CONFIDENCE OVER HYPE

❌ "Transform your English in 7 days with our SECRET METHOD!"  

✅ "1 hour a day. 90 days. Real confidence. Guaranteed."



### 4. EMPATHY FIRST

❌ "Why is your English still bad after 10 years?"  

✅ "You're not bad at English. The system you learned in was broken."



### 5. SHOW, DON'T JUST TELL

❌ "We have amazing teachers!"  

✅ "Our teachers interrupt you mid-sentence — not to correct, but to celebrate your courage."



---



## 7.2 TONE VARIATIONS BY CONTEXT



### MARKETING (BOLD & MOTIVATING)

- Short, punchy sentences

- Active voice

- Direct address ("you")

- Challenge existing beliefs

- Paint clear before/after picture



**EXAMPLE:**

> "You spent 10 years learning English in school. You can read. You can write. But when it's time to speak? Nothing comes out. That ends now. NET breaks the silence."



---



### TEACHING (SUPPORTIVE & CLEAR)

- Warm, encouraging

- Clear instructions

- Positive reinforcement

- Growth mindset language

- Celebrate mistakes



**EXAMPLE:**

> "Great job! You spoke for 30 seconds without stopping. That's confidence. Don't worry about that grammar mistake — we'll fix it naturally over time. Keep that Tiger energy!"



---



### SALES (CONSULTATIVE & HONEST)

- Listen more than pitch

- Ask diagnostic questions

- Present solutions, not products

- Acknowledge concerns

- No pressure, just clarity



**EXAMPLE:**

> "Let me ask you something: What happens when you try to speak English right now? Do words come out? Or does your mind go blank? <pause> That's what I thought. Here's why that happens..."



---



### CORPORATE (PROFESSIONAL & DATA-DRIVEN)

- Business language

- ROI focus

- Metrics and results

- Case studies

- Professional tone



**EXAMPLE:**

> "Companies investing in NET see a 300% increase in employee English confidence within 90 days. Our enterprise dashboard tracks individual progress, team metrics, and ROI in real-time."



---



## 7.3 WORD CHOICES



### ✅ USE THESE WORDS



**EMPOWERMENT:**

- Transform, breakthrough, unlock, freedom, liberation

- Confidence, courage, power, strength

- Break free, escape, rise, emerge



**ACTION:**

- Speak, practice, build, grow, achieve

- Start, begin, jump, dive, commit



**NATURAL ACQUISITION:**

- Natural, effortless, authentic, real, genuine

- Conversation, communication, fluency

- Like learning Vietnamese (powerful comparison)



**COMMUNITY:**

- Together, buddy, partner, community, tribe

- Support, encourage, celebrate, share



**RESULTS:**

- Guaranteed, proven, measurable, real

- 90 days, 1 hour daily, 80% completion rate

- Confidence first, grammar second



---



### ❌ AVOID THESE WORDS



**OVERUSED EDU-JARGON:**

- Methodology, pedagogy, curriculum (use simpler terms)

- Optimize, leverage, synergy (corporate cringe)

- Revolutionary, innovative (show, don't claim)



**NEGATIVE LANGUAGE:**

- Failure, bad, wrong, stupid, impossible

- Can't, won't, never (unless reframing: "You'll never go back")

- Difficult, hard, complicated (makes learning scary)



**GENERIC CLAIMS:**

- Best, #1, top-rated (meaningless without proof)

- Easy, quick, fast (feels scammy)

- Perfect, master (sets unrealistic expectations)



**FALSE PROMISES:**

- Fluent in X days (dishonest)

- No effort required (lazy)

- Secret method (gimmicky)



---



## 7.4 SENTENCE STRUCTURE



### SHORT = POWERFUL

```

❌ "Our comprehensive approach to English language acquisition prioritizes confidence-building over grammatical perfection."



✅ "Confidence first. Grammar second."

```



### ACTIVE > PASSIVE

```

❌ "English is taught by focusing on natural conversation."



✅ "We teach English through natural conversation."

```



### CONCRETE > ABSTRACT

```

❌ "We facilitate transformative linguistic development."



✅ "We turn Mouse Voice into Tiger Voice."

```



---

(() => {

  const Security = {

      const map = { '<':'&lt;', '>':'&gt;', '"':'&quot;', "'":'&#x27;', '/':'&#x2F;' };
      return str.replace(/[<>"'/]/g, m => map[m]);
    },
    auditLog: (type, details) => {
      console.log(`[SEC_AUDIT][${new Date().toISOString()}] ${type}:`, details);
    },
    validateNoInlineHandlers: () => {
      // P0 Mandate: No inline 'on' attributes
      const illegal = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[onclick],[onmouseover],[onload]'));
      if(illegal.length) Security.auditLog('INLINE_HANDLER_VIOLATION', illegal);
    }
  };

  // ==========================
  // 2. GOSPEL 444 UI ENGINE
  // ==========================
  const UI = {
    config: { 
      colors: { purple: '#a855f7', gold: '#f59e0b', dark: '#0f0f1a' },

    },
    applyGlow: (el) => { 
      el.style.boxShadow = `0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4)`; 
    },
    initTheme: () => {
      document.body.style.backgroundColor = UI.config.colors.dark;
      document.body.style.color = '#ffffff';
      document.body.style.fontFamily = "'Inter', sans-serif"; // Primary Font
    }
  };

  // ==========================
  // 3. NET PET AI CORE
  // ==========================
  const NET_PET = {
    state: { xp: 0, level: 1, streak: 0, mood: 'neutral' },
    addXP: (amount) => {
      NET_PET.state.xp += amount;
      Security.auditLog('XP_GAIN', { amount, total: NET_PET.state.xp });
      // Mouse to Tiger progression thresholds
      if(NET_PET.state.xp > 500) NET_PET.state.level = 4; // Zenith State
      else if(NET_PET.state.xp > 250) NET_PET.state.level = 3;
      else if(NET_PET.state.xp > 100) NET_PET.state.level = 2;
    }
  };

  // ==========================
  // 4. STORYFLOW & VOICE ENGINE
  // ==========================
  const StoryFlow = {
    Arcs: { 
      BREACH: { lvl: 1, prompt: 'Whisper the truth.' },
      ARENA:  { lvl: 2, prompt: 'Declare your presence.' },
      ZENITH: { lvl: 3, prompt: 'Roar.' } 
    },
    processVoiceMetric: (hesitationCount, volumeDb) => {
      // Tiger Voice Logic: Volume > 65dB + Low Hesitation
      if(volumeDb > 65 && hesitationCount < 2) {
        NET_PET.addXP(100);
        return "🐯 TIGER DETECTED: POWER SURGE!";
      }
      return "🐭 MOUSE DETECTED: APPLYING ENCOURAGEMENT...";
    }
  };

  // ==========================
  // 5. SYSTEM INITIALIZATION
  // ==========================
  const init = () => {
    UI.initTheme();
    Security.validateNoInlineHandlers();
    
    // Bind Action Handlers (Strictly via data-attributes)
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-net-action]').forEach(el => {

        if(action === 'roar') NET_PET.addXP(50);
      });
    });

    console.log("🔥 PHOENIX RISING: MONOLITH REINCARNATED 🔥");
  };

})();

<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>NET L10 — THE POWER PITCH</title>

    <style>

        :root {

            --bg: #0a0a0f;

            --panel: #12121e;

            --accent: #a855f7; /* Neon Purple */

            --gold: #f59e0b;   /* Gospel Gold */

            --text: #e2e8f0;

            --danger: #ef4444;

            --success: #22c55e;

            --border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);

        }



        body, html {

            margin: 0;

            padding: 0;

            height: 100%;

            background-color: var(--bg);

            color: var(--text);

            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;

            overflow: hidden;

        }



        /* --- BACKGROUND EFFECTS --- */

        .grid-overlay {

            position: fixed;

            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;

            background-image: linear-gradient(var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px),

                              linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);

            background-size: 50px 50px;

            z-index: -1;

            opacity: 0.1;

        }



        /* --- HUD TERMINAL --- */

        #net-terminal {

            position: fixed;

            bottom: 20px;

            right: 20px;

            width: 380px;

            height: 220px;

            background: rgba(18, 18, 30, 0.9);

            border: 1px solid var(--accent);

            border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);

            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);

            display: flex;

            flex-direction: column;

            z-index: 1000;

            font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

            font-size: 0.8rem;

        }



        #terminal-header {

            background: var(--accent);

            color: black;

            padding: 4px 10px;

            font-weight: bold;

            display: flex;

            justify-content: space-between;

        }



        #net-output {

            flex-grow: 1;

            padding: 10px;

            overflow-y: auto;

            color: var(--accent);

        }



        .terminal-input-row {

            display: flex;

            padding: 5px 10px;

            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);

        }



        .terminal-input-row span { color: var(--gold); margin-right: 5px; }



        #terminal-input {

            background: transparent;

            border: none;

            color: white;

            outline: none;

            flex-grow: 1;

        }



        /* --- ROOM SYSTEM --- */

        .room {

            display: none;

            height: 100vh;

            flex-direction: column;

            align-items: center;

            justify-content: center;

            padding: 20px;

            box-sizing: border-box;

        }



        .room.active { display: flex; }



        h1 {

            font-size: 3.5rem;

            color: var(--gold);

            text-transform: uppercase;

            letter-spacing: 5px;

            margin: 0;

            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);

        }



        .subtitle {

            font-size: 1.2rem;

            color: var(--accent);

            letter-spacing: 2px;

            margin-bottom: 40px;

        }



        /* --- INTEL CARDS --- */

        .card-grid {

            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

            gap: 25px;

            max-width: 900px;

        }



        .phrase-card {

            background: var(--panel);

            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            padding: 30px 20px;

            border-radius: 4px;

            cursor: pointer;

            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);

            text-align: center;

            position: relative;

            overflow: hidden;

        }



        .phrase-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-5px); }



        .phrase-card.downloaded {

            border-color: var(--gold);

            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);

            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05);

        }



        .phrase-card.downloaded::after {

            content: "✓ DOWNLOADED";

            position: absolute;

            top: 5px;

            right: 5px;

            font-size: 0.6rem;

            color: var(--gold);

        }



        /* --- GAUNTLET TIMER --- */

        .timer-container {

            width: 600px;

            text-align: center;

        }



        #timer-track {

            width: 100%;

            height: 12px;

            background: #1a1a2e;

            border-radius: 6px;

            margin: 20px 0;

            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            overflow: hidden;

        }



        #timer-fill {

            width: 100%;

            height: 100%;

            background: var(--success);

            transition: width 1s linear, background-color 0.5s;

        }



        .coach-box {

            background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);

            border: 1px dashed var(--accent);

            padding: 20px;

            margin-top: 30px;

            border-radius: 8px;

            min-height: 80px;

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            justify-content: center;

            font-style: italic;

        }



        /* --- BUTTONS --- */

        .btn-action {

            background: var(--gold);

            color: black;

            border: none;

            padding: 15px 40px;

            font-weight: 900;

            text-transform: uppercase;

            letter-spacing: 2px;

            cursor: pointer;

            border-radius: 4px;

            transition: 0.3s;

            margin-top: 20px;

        }



        .btn-action:hover {

            transform: scale(1.05);

            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);

        }



        .btn-action:disabled {

            background: #444;

            cursor: not-allowed;

            transform: none;

            box-shadow: none;

        }



        /* --- SUCCESS PULSE --- */

        @keyframes pulse-gold {

            0% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold); }

            50% { text-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--gold); }

            100% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold); }

        }

        .success-text { animation: pulse-gold 2s infinite; }



    </style>

</head>

<body>



<div class="grid-overlay"></div>



<div id="room0" class="room active">

    <h1>Identity Scan</h1>

    <div class="subtitle">Class C: Corporate Ops // Signal Detected</div>

    <div style="background: var(--panel); padding: 30px; border-left: 4px solid var(--gold); max-width: 600px;">

        <p><strong>MISSION:</strong> Transform from "Mouse Voice" to "Tiger Voice".</p>

        <p><strong>SCENARIO:</strong> You are in an elevator with the CTO of BlueTech. You have 60 seconds to pitch your infrastructure upgrade. Make every second an ROI asset.</p>

    </div>

    <button class="btn-action" onclick="transitionRoom(1)">Verify Identity & Proceed</button>

</div>



<div id="room1" class="room">

    <h1>Intel Brief</h1>

    <div class="subtitle">Download Executive Power Phrases</div>

    <div class="card-grid">

        <div class="phrase-card" id="card1" onclick="downloadIntel(1)">

            <h3>PROBLEM</h3>

            <p>"The core bottleneck we're solving is..."</p>

        </div>

        <div class="phrase-card" id="card2" onclick="downloadIntel(2)">

            <h3>SOLUTION</h3>

            <p>"Our approach differentiates by..."</p>

        </div>

        <div class="phrase-card" id="card3" onclick="downloadIntel(3)">

            <h3>IMPACT</h3>

            <p>"The ROI timeline is projected at..."</p>

        </div>

    </div>

    <button id="intel-btn" class="btn-action" disabled onclick="transitionRoom(2)">Enter The Gauntlet</button>

</div>



<div id="room2" class="room">

    <h1 id="timer-display">60.0s</h1>

    <div class="subtitle">THE EXECUTIVE GAUNTLET</div>

    

    <div class="timer-container">

        <div id="timer-track"><div id="timer-fill"></div></div>

        <div class="coach-box" id="coach-hint">

            Waiting for Agent to initiate pitch...

        </div>

    </div>



    <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px;">

        <button id="start-btn" class="btn-action" onclick="startPitch()">Start Pitch</button>

        <button id="finish-btn" class="btn-action" style="background: transparent; border: 1px solid white; color: white;" onclick="endPitch()" disabled>End Pitch</button>

    </div>

</div>



<div id="room3" class="room">

    <h1 class="success-text">Mission Success</h1>

    <div class="subtitle">Tiger Voice Calibrated</div>

    <div id="feedback-report" style="background: var(--panel); padding: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--gold); text-align: left; max-width: 500px;">

        </div>

    <button class="btn-action" onclick="location.reload()">Re-run Simulation</button>

</div>



<div id="net-terminal">

    <div id="terminal-header">

        <span>PHOENIX_v30.35</span>

        <span>L10_POWER_PITCH</span>

    </div>

    <div id="net-output">

        <div>[SYSTEM]: Connection established.</div>

        <div>[SYSTEM]: Awaiting Agent verification...</div>

    </div>

    <div class="terminal-input-row">

        <span>></span>

        <input type="text" id="terminal-input" placeholder="Enter /command..." onkeypress="handleCommand(event)">

    </div>

</div>



<script>

    let currentRoom = 0;

    let downloads = new Set();

    let pitchTimer = null;

    let secondsLeft = 60;

    let pitchData = { startTime: 0, endTime: 0 };



    function log(msg, type = "SYSTEM") {

        const out = document.getElementById('net-output');

        const color = type === "USER" ? "#f59e0b" : "#a855f7";

        out.innerHTML += `<div><span style="color:${color}">[${type}]</span>: ${msg}</div>`;

        out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;

    }



    function transitionRoom(n) {

        document.querySelectorAll('.room').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));

        document.getElementById(`room${n}`).classList.add('active');

        currentRoom = n;

        log(`Transitioning to ROOM_${n}...`);

    }



    function downloadIntel(id) {

        downloads.add(id);

        document.getElementById(`card${id}`).classList.add('downloaded');

        log(`Power Phrase ${id} integrated into neural buffer.`);

        

        if(downloads.size === 3) {

            document.getElementById('intel-btn').disabled = false;

            log("All Intel downloaded. Gauntlet unlocked.", "SECURITY");

        }

    }



    function startPitch() {

        document.getElementById('start-btn').disabled = true;

        document.getElementById('finish-btn').disabled = false;

        log("PITCH_SEQUENCE_START", "GAUNTLET");

        

        pitchTimer = setInterval(() => {

            secondsLeft -= 0.1;

            updateUI();

            

            if(secondsLeft <= 0) {

                endPitch();

            }

        }, 100);

    }



    function updateUI() {

        const display = document.getElementById('timer-display');

        const fill = document.getElementById('timer-fill');

        const hint = document.getElementById('coach-hint');

        

        display.innerText = secondsLeft.toFixed(1) + "s";

        let percentage = (secondsLeft / 60) * 100;

        fill.style.width = percentage + "%";



        // Dynamic Color & Hints

        if(secondsLeft > 40) {

            fill.style.backgroundColor = "#22c55e";

            hint.innerText = "PHASE 1: Define the Problem. Keep it sharp and painful.";

        } else if (secondsLeft > 15) {

            fill.style.backgroundColor = "#f59e0b";

            hint.innerText = "PHASE 2: Present the Solution. Highlight the 'How' and 'Why'.";

        } else {

            fill.style.backgroundColor = "#ef4444";

            hint.innerText = "PHASE 3: ROI & Close. Tell them the impact and call to action!";

        }

    }



    function endPitch() {

        clearInterval(pitchTimer);

        log("PITCH_SEQUENCE_COMPLETE", "GAUNTLET");

        

        const report = document.getElementById('feedback-report');

        const performance = secondsLeft > 5 ? "TIGER" : "ELITE_TIGER";

        

        report.innerHTML = `

            <h3 style="color:var(--gold); margin-top:0;">POST-ACTION REPORT</h3>

            <p><strong>Agent Level:</strong> ${performance}</p>

            <p><strong>Time Remaining:</strong> ${secondsLeft.toFixed(1)}s</p>

            <p><strong>Impact Score:</strong> 98%</p>

            <hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid var(--border);">

            <p style="font-size:0.9rem;">You delivered the pitch with authority. The "Mouse Voice" has been successfully purged. Corporate leadership is impressed.</p>

        `;

        

        transitionRoom(3);

    }



    function handleCommand(e) {

        if(e.key === 'Enter') {

            const cmd = e.target.value.toLowerCase();

            log(cmd, "USER");

            

            if(cmd === '/audit') log("System Integrity: 100% | Gospel 444 Compliant", "SECURITY");

            else if(cmd === '/skip') transitionRoom(3);

            else if(cmd === '/xp') log("Current Lesson XP: +444", "STATS");

            else log("Unknown command protocol.", "ERROR");

            

            e.target.value = '';

        }

    }



    // Initialize

    log("Awaiting Identity Scan...");

</script>

<style>

:root {

--bg: #0a0a0f;

}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }


body, html {

margin: 0;

padding: 0;

width: 100%;

height: 100%;

background-color: var(--bg);

color: var(--text-main);

font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;

overflow: hidden;

}



/* 4-ROOM HUD STRUCTURE */

#hud-container {

display: flex;

flex-direction: column;

width: 100vw;

height: 100vh;

position: relative;

}



.room {

display: none;

flex: 1;

padding: 40px;

flex-direction: column;

align-items: center;

justify-content: center;

animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;

}



.room.active { display: flex; }



@keyframes fadeIn {

from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }

to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

}



/* UI ELEMENTS */

.header {

text-align: center;

margin-bottom: 40px;

}



.lesson-id {

color: var(--soul);

font-weight: 800;

letter-spacing: 2px;

font-size: 0.9rem;

margin-bottom: 8px;

}



h1 {

font-size: 2.5rem;

margin: 0;

text-transform: uppercase;

letter-spacing: -1px;

background: linear-gradient(to right, #fff, var(--soul));

-webkit-background-clip: text;

-webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;

}



.subtitle {

color: var(--text-dim);

font-size: 1.1rem;

margin-top: 10px;

}



/* IDENTITY SCAN (ROOM 0) */

.identity-card {

background: var(--surface);

border: 1px solid var(--soul);

padding: 40px;

border-radius: 20px;

text-align: center;

max-width: 500px;

box-shadow: var(--glow-purple);

}



/* INTEL BRIEF (ROOM 1) */

.card-grid {

display: grid;

grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

gap: 20px;

width: 100%;

max-width: 1000px;

}



.phrase-card {

background: var(--surface);

border: 1px solid #333;

padding: 30px;

border-radius: 12px;

cursor: pointer;

transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

text-align: center;

position: relative;

}



.phrase-card:hover {

border-color: var(--soul);

transform: translateY(-5px);

}



.phrase-card.downloaded {

border-color: var(--gold);

box-shadow: var(--glow-gold);

}



.phrase-card code {

display: block;

margin-bottom: 15px;

color: var(--soul);

font-size: 1.1rem;

font-weight: bold;

}



/* THE GAUNTLET (ROOM 2) */

#gauntlet-sim {

width: 100%;

max-width: 800px;

background: var(--surface);

border-radius: 16px;

padding: 40px;

border: 1px solid #333;

position: relative;

}



.ceo-prompt {

border-left: 4px solid var(--soul);

padding-left: 20px;

margin-bottom: 30px;

font-style: italic;

font-size: 1.3rem;

color: var(--text-dim);

}



.timer-container {

width: 100%;

height: 12px;

background: #222;

border-radius: 6px;

overflow: hidden;

margin: 20px 0;

}



#timer-bar {

height: 100%;

width: 100%;

background: var(--success);

transition: width 1s linear, background-color 0.3s ease;

}



.stage-indicator {

display: flex;

justify-content: space-between;

margin-top: 10px;

font-size: 0.8rem;

text-transform: uppercase;

color: var(--text-dim);

font-weight: bold;

}



/* BUTTONS */

.btn {

background: var(--soul);

color: white;

border: none;

padding: 15px 40px;

border-radius: 30px;

font-weight: bold;

text-transform: uppercase;

cursor: pointer;

transition: all 0.2s;

margin-top: 20px;

letter-spacing: 1px;

}



.btn:hover {

transform: scale(1.05);

filter: brightness(1.2);

}



.btn:disabled {

background: #333;

color: #666;

cursor: not-allowed;

transform: none;

}



.btn-ghost {

background: transparent;

border: 1px solid var(--soul);

color: var(--soul);

}



/* SUCCESS NODE (ROOM 3) */

.stat-circle {

width: 180px;

height: 180px;

border: 4px solid var(--gold);

border-radius: 50%;

display: flex;

align-items: center;

justify-content: center;

font-size: 1.8rem;

font-weight: 800;

margin: 20px auto;

box-shadow: var(--glow-gold);

background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);

}



/* COACH MODE */

#coach-tips {

margin-top: 20px;

padding: 15px;

background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);

border: 1px dashed var(--soul);

border-radius: 8px;

}



/* REINCARNATION MONOLITH (Footer Logic) */

.monolith-sync {

position: absolute;

bottom: 20px;

color: #444;

pointer-events: none;

}

<script>

let downloads = { 1: false, 2: false, 3: false };

let timerInterval;

let timeLeft = 60;

let pitchStarted = false;

function nextRoom(roomNum) {

document.querySelectorAll(&#39;.room&#39;).forEach(r =&gt; r.classList.remove(&#39;active&#39;));

document.getElementById(`room${roomNum}`).classList.add(&#39;active&#39;);

}



function downloadPhrase(id) {

downloads[id] = true;

const card = document.getElementById(`card${id}`);

card.classList.add(&#39;downloaded&#39;);

card.querySelector(&#39;.status&#39;).innerText = &#39;DOWNLOADED ✓&#39;;

card.querySelector(&#39;.status&#39;).style.color = &#39;var(--gold)&#39;;



if (downloads[1] &amp;&amp; downloads[2] &amp;&amp; downloads[3]) {

const nextBtn = document.getElementById(&#39;intel-next&#39;);

nextBtn.disabled = false;

nextBtn.style.boxShadow = &#39;var(--glow-purple)&#39;;

}

}



function toggleCoach() {

const tips = document.getElementById(&#39;coach-tips&#39;);

tips.style.display = tips.style.display === &#39;block&#39; ? &#39;none&#39; : &#39;block&#39;;

}



function startGauntlet() {

pitchStarted = true;

document.getElementById(&#39;start-pitch&#39;).style.display = &#39;none&#39;;

document.getElementById(&#39;stop-pitch&#39;).style.display = &#39;inline-block&#39;;


timeLeft = 60;

const bar = document.getElementById(&#39;timer-bar&#39;);

const text = document.getElementById(&#39;timer-text&#39;);


timerInterval = setInterval(() =&gt; {

timeLeft--;

text.innerText = timeLeft + &#39;s&#39;;


let percentage = (timeLeft / 60) * 100;

bar.style.width = percentage + &#39;%&#39;;



// Visual Logic: Green -&gt; Gold -&gt; Red

if (timeLeft &lt;= 15) {

bar.style.backgroundColor = &#39;var(--danger)&#39;;

} else if (timeLeft &lt;= 30) {

bar.style.backgroundColor = &#39;var(--gold)&#39;;

}



// Phase Tracking Logic

updateStageIndicators(timeLeft);



if (timeLeft &lt;= 0) {

endGauntlet();

}

}, 1000);

}



function updateStageIndicators(time) {

const p = document.getElementById(&#39;stage-problem&#39;);

const s = document.getElementById(&#39;stage-solution&#39;);

const r = document.getElementById(&#39;stage-roi&#39;);



// Reset colors

p.style.color = s.style.color = r.style.color = &#39;var(--text-dim)&#39;;

p.style.textShadow = s.style.textShadow = r.style.textShadow = &#39;none&#39;;



if (time &gt; 40) {

p.style.color = &#39;var(--gold)&#39;;

p.style.textShadow = &#39;0 0 10px var(--glow-gold)&#39;;

} else if (time &gt; 15) {

s.style.color = &#39;var(--gold)&#39;;

s.style.textShadow = &#39;0 0 10px var(--glow-gold)&#39;;

:root {

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body, html {

margin: 0;

padding: 0;

width: 100%;

height: 100%;

background-color: var(--bg);

color: var(--text-main);

font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;

overflow: hidden;

}



/* 4-ROOM HUD STRUCTURE */

#hud-container {

display: flex;

flex-direction: column;

width: 100vw;

height: 100vh;

position: relative;

}



.room {

display: none;

flex: 1;

padding: 40px;

flex-direction: column;

align-items: center;

justify-content: center;

animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out;

}



.room.active { display: flex; }



@keyframes fadeIn {

from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }

to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

}



/* UI ELEMENTS */

.header {

text-align: center;

margin-bottom: 40px;

}



.lesson-id {

color: var(--soul);

font-weight: 800;

.card-grid {

display: grid;

gap: 20px;

width: 100%;

max-width: 1000px;

}



.phrase-card {

background: var(--surface);

border: 1px solid #333;

padding: 30px;

border-radius: 12px;

cursor: pointer;

transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

text-align: center;

position: relative;

}



.phrase-card:hover {

border-color: var(--soul);

transform: translateY(-5px);

}



.phrase-card.downloaded {

border-color: var(--gold);

box-shadow: var(--glow-gold);

}



.phrase-card code {

display: block;

margin-bottom: 15px;

color: var(--soul);

font-size: 1.1rem;

font-weight: bold;

}

#gauntlet-sim {

padding: 40px;

border: 1px solid #333;

position: relative;

border-left: 4px solid var(--soul);

padding-left: 20px;

margin-bottom: 30px;

font-style: italic;

font-size: 1.3rem;

color: var(--text-dim);

}



.timer-container {

width: 100%;

height: 12px;

background: #222;

border-radius: 6px;

overflow: hidden;

margin: 20px 0;

}



#timer-bar {

height: 100%;

width: 100%;

background: var(--success);

transition: width 1s linear, background-color 0.3s ease;

}



.stage-indicator {

display: flex;

justify-content: space-between;

margin-top: 10px;

font-size: 0.8rem;

text-transform: uppercase;

color: var(--text-dim);

font-weight: bold;

}



/* BUTTONS */

.btn {

background: var(--soul);

color: white;

border: none;

padding: 15px 40px;

border-radius: 30px;

font-weight: bold;

text-transform: uppercase;

cursor: pointer;

transition: all 0.2s;

margin-top: 20px;

letter-spacing: 1px;

}



.btn:hover {

transform: scale(1.05);

filter: brightness(1.2);

}



.btn:disabled {

background: #333;

color: #666;

cursor: not-allowed;

transform: none;

}



.btn-ghost {

background: transparent;

color: var(--soul);

}



/* SUCCESS NODE (ROOM 3) */

.stat-circle {

const amplitude = 2 + depth * 2; // vertical translation (px)

const pulseDuration = (1.2 + depth * 0.2).toFixed(2) + 's';



const label = <span class="wave ${colorClass}" style=" animation-delay:${baseDelay}s; animation-duration:${waveDuration},${pulseDuration}; transform: translateY(0); ">${node.label}</span>;



const roles = node.roles ? ${indent}Roles: ${node.roles} : "";

const emojis = node.emojis ? node.emojis.map((e, idx) => {

const emojiDelay = baseDelay + idx * 0.05; // slight phase offset

return <span class="emoji-wave ${colorClass}" style=" animation-delay:${emojiDelay}s; animation-duration:${waveDuration},${pulseDuration}; transform: translateY(0); ">${e}</span>;

}).join('') : "";



let str = ${indent}${label}\n;

if (roles) str += ${roles}\n;

if (emojis) str += ${indent}Emojis: ${emojis}\n;



if (node.children) {

node.children.forEach((child, idx) => {

str += renderNode(child, depth + 1, idx);

});

}

return str;

}
